name: Centennial Parkside CDC
statusReason: Site is live with content through 2023-2024 (annual report, ED job posting) and IRS 990s through 2023; organization is operating.
notes: Founded 2015 by East Parkside residents (Parkside Journal 'New CDC launches' article, Sept 2015); IRS recognized 2016. Chris Spahr listed as ED on 2018-2019 Wayback staff snapshots; a Sept 2023 ED job posting indicates a vacancy/transition before Jessi Ray Koch (current staff page). No explicit incorporation date stated.

name: Germantown United CDC
statusReason: Site live with news/staff content through 2024-2025 and IRS 990s through 2023; new ED hired Nov 2024.
notes: Founded 2011 by citizens/neighborhood orgs (John Churchville was first president). Andy Trackman was the inaugural ED (named Feb 2014, since deceased). Emaleigh Doley was with the org ~9 years and ED for the final ~3, departing June 28 2024. Leo Dillinger IV became ED early Nov 2024. Batch's currentExec (Emaleigh Doley) is outdated.

name: ICPIC New Africa Center CDC
statusReason: newafricacenter.com live with current center hours, membership pricing, and citations through 2021; organization actively operating the museum/center.
notes: ICPIC (Islamic Cultural Preservation and Information Council) founded 1991; the permanent New Africa Center / Muslim American Museum & Archive opened June 2005. Annual Islamic Festival and Parade has run since 1993. No EIN/990 data in batch (IRS fields null). Abdul-Rahim Muhammad is founder/CEO and founding director.

name: Mt. Vernon Manor CDC
statusReason: Site live with current staff/programs and IRS 990s through 2023; ED Michael Thorpe running day-to-day operations.
notes: Site states 'local leaders formed the Mt. Vernon Manor CDC in 1977.' IRS 'recognized' date of 1966-11-01 in batch predates the site's stated founding (likely an associated/predecessor entity record). Michael Thorpe is ED since 2015; Paury Flowers is Deputy Director. Batch's currentExec 'Robert Madden (President)' is likely the board president, not the operating ED.

name: Olney Community Collaborative
statusReason: Site live with blog posts and events through 2024; rebranded and received 501(c)(3) status in 2024 (IRS recognized 2024-07).
notes: Originally established 2005 as the North 5th Street Revitalization Project (N5SRP) by Olney residents and small business owners; received 501(c)(3) status and rebranded as Olney Community Collaborative in 2024. Stephanie Michel has been with the org since 2010 (AmeriCorps VISTA), rising through Program Coordinator/Assistant Director/Co-director to Executive Director. Board president: Marjorie Burnett.

name: Sister Clara Muhammad CDC
statusReason: Site live with 2024 copyright and active development/signup content; IRS 990s through 2023.
notes: No explicit founding year stated on site; IRS recognized 2009-09-01 and first 990 in 2011, suggesting formation ~2009. The CDC is anchored by The Philadelphia Masjid; the site's 'cornerstone for over five decades' refers to the masjid campus, not the CDC. Hassan Abdellah listed as Treasurer. Roger Powe (current ED) from batch not independently confirmed on site, but no contradicting evidence found.

name: Tioga United
statusReason: Site live with press releases and events through 2024 and IRS 990s through 2023; operating as a Neighborhood Advisory Committee.
notes: Started informally in 1996 as 'Unity Day Tioga'; incorporated 2001 (IRS recognized 2002-05). Current site lists NAC Coordinator (Joy Gary) and Outreach Coordinator (Terrell Brown) rather than a titled ED. Batch's currentExec 'David Smith (President)' not confirmed in a president role on the current site; David Smith appears on a 2013 members list as a 'Realtor Advisor.' No current ED title surfaced.

name: Allegheny West Foundation
statusReason: Site live with 2025 content (food giveaways, May 2025 newsletter, April 2025 mayoral press conference); IRS 990s through 2022.
notes: About page states the organization 'was established in 1968 and officially incorporated in 1974' (IRS recognized 1974-07). Ronald E. Hinton Jr. is President & CEO (matches batch). Board leadership: Norma B. Carter (Chairwoman/Secretary), Ken Curry (Vice Chairman), Stacy Shields (Treasurer).
